implementation: Canonical publisher persists candidate associations before assessment/lineage, keeping all rows in one atomic transaction. This permits a legitimate WAL read-to-write upgrade race to be observed before the publisher holds a write lock. On SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT it rolls back and restarts the complete transaction with a fresh snapshot.
visibility_retry_path: REMOVED. Physical SQLite evidence shows BUSY_SNAPSHOT is the real signal before write; a missing post-insert row is a hard runtime correctness failure, not a second retry mechanism.
